nodes.description: Public uint256 cap on total THING supply, writable by owner via setMaxThings and read in mintThing/setStartingIndexAndMintReserve.
Public uint256 maximum number of tokens purchasable in one mintThing call.
Public uint256 number of reserved tokens minted by setStartingIndexAndMintReserve and skipped in mintThing id logic.
Public uint256 mint price in wei (0.08 ETH) compared against msg.value in mintThing.
Public uint256 price required to change name/description a second time.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) of pre-party purchase allowances, decremented in mintThing and incremented by authoriseThing.
Private mapping(uint256=>bool) tracking whether a token already consumed its free rename.
Private State enum controlling whether minting is enabled (Setup/PreParty/Party).
Private uint256 counter of the next token id to mint, advanced inside mintThing.
Private uint256 offset derived from blockhash used to shift minted id ranges.
Private string base URI returned by baseTokenURI for token metadata.
Private string contract-level URI returned by contractURI.
Private address in Ownable that governs the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
Public unguarded function that derives _startingIndex from blockhash(block.number-1) and safe-mints AMOUNT_RESERVED tokens to a caller-supplied address.
Payable nonReentrant entry point that sells up to MAX_PURCHASE tokens, charges THING_PRICE and safe-mints to msg.sender.
Payable function letting a token owner set metadata; charges RENAME_PRICE on repeat changes.

Internal burn clearing approvals, balances and token URI storage.

blockhash(block.number-1) % MAX_THINGS used to derive _startingIndex; miner-influenceable and predictable randomness.

Number of tokens requested in mintThing; bounded by MAX_PURCHASE and MAX_THINGS.

New description string emitted in NameAndDescriptionChanged.
Destination address for the full contract balance in withdrawAllEth.
Address receiving a pre-party allowance in authoriseThing.
Allowance amount added to _authorised for a human.
Array of addresses authorised in batch.
Allowance applied to every address in the batch loop.
New MAX_THINGS value supplied by the owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller whose pre-party allowance in _authorised gates the mint.
_msgSender() must equal the resolved token owner before metadata can be changed.
msg.sender indexes _authorised for allowance reads and decrements.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() to _owner before draining the balance.
onlyOwner restricts allowance granting to the owner identity.
onlyOwner gates the Setup to PreParty transition.
_owner governs the onlyOwner modifier used across administrative functions.
setStartingIndexAndMintReserve derives its randomness from blockhash of the previous block.
Miner-influenceable blockhash result is stored into _startingIndex.
The reserve loop calls _safeMint, invoking recipient code during minting.
_startingIndex is repeatedly incremented inside the reserve loop.
MAX_THINGS bounds the computed starting index.
AMOUNT_RESERVED determines the loop bound and index clamping.
_safeMint delegates state updates to _mint.
_safeMint performs the recipient onERC721Received callback after minting.
The external onERC721Received invocation hands control to an untrusted recipient.
mintThing mints to msg.sender via _safeMint, which calls back into recipient contracts.
_nextTokenId is read and advanced for each minted token.
Pre-party allowance is consumed from _authorised.
_state must not be Setup and selects the pre-party branch.
MAX_PURCHASE caps amountOfThings per call.
totalSupply plus amountOfThings must stay below MAX_THINGS.
THING_PRICE.mul(amountOfThings) is compared to msg.value for the required payment.
_startingIndex and AMOUNT_RESERVED shift _nextTokenId past the reserved range.
AMOUNT_RESERVED is used to detect the reserved id window.
_nameChanged decides whether the rename fee is required and is then set.
RENAME_PRICE must exactly equal the supplied msg.value on repeat changes.
amountPaid captures msg.value for the price comparisons.
withdrawAllEth forwards the entire balance through sendValue to a supplied address.
The owner-controlled payout invokes a low-level value transfer to an arbitrary payee.
_owner is checked by the onlyOwner modifier guarding the withdrawal.
sendValue executes the low-level call with all remaining gas forwarded.
authoriseThing increases the _authorised allowance for a human.
authoriseThingBatch loops and delegates each entry to authoriseThing.
startPreParty writes the _state enum.
setStateToParty writes the _state enum.
setContractURL writes _contractUriBase.
setTokenURI writes _tokenUriBase.
setMaxThings writes MAX_THINGS.
setMaxPurchase writes MAX_PURCHASE.
setAmountReserve writes AMOUNT_RESERVED.
setThingPrice writes THING_PRICE.
setRenamePrice writes RENAME_PRICE.
transferOwnership delegates the write to _setOwner.
_owner is rewritten to the new owner address.
renounceOwnership delegates the write to _setOwner.
_setOwner assigns the _owner state variable.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() to the recipient callback.
functionCallWithValue performs a low-level value call to an arbitrary target.
_transfer updates the caller-indexed balance mapping during transfers.
